== Decipher replacement-text authority and date ==
The complete replacement wording for [[Disarmed (Errata)|Disarmed]] appears in Decipher’s November 1998 Star Wars CCG Glossary, Version 2.0, PDF page 50. The later Players Committee Appendix A reproduces this wording. Released uses the Decipher documentary bound. The Holotable illustration is a separate source copy; its image date is not this text state’s publication date. The printed Title property, publisher and Errata label follow the primary authority; the GEMP identifier, complete game text, Lore, statistics and images are preserved. [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Primary document]. Recovered full document: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0 (PDF)]].
